summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built, trained and evaluated PyTorch deep learning models across vision, speech and language, including a DONUT fine-tune that lifted validation accuracy from 55% to 93%. Handled model deployment and real-time low-latency inference with ONNX, TFLite and TensorRT (5.2× speedup), backed by rigorous model evaluation and benchmarking.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% by fine-tuning DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built PyTorch model training and preprocessing pipelines with the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific special tokens and resized the decoder embedding layer.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images, achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile model deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19 and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU and reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.
Engineered a BraTS 2020 MRI data pipeline with augmentation and batch-loading memory management for 3D volumetric inputs.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Cut YOLO inference from 56.7 to 10.9 ms (5.2× speedup, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) with TensorRT for real-time, low-latency visual servoing in a voice-controlled pick-and-place system.

Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s) and Gemini intent classification (<500ms) over a Flask-SocketIO edge server; resolved 11 integration failures and achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory ~55% with 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency with pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked on HellaSwag, GSM8K and ARC: <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end Whisper-style ASR pipeline (80-channel mel encoder, 4-block causal Transformer decoder) in PyTorch, achieving 15% WER on 1,000 Indian-English samples.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython backend, 4–5.5× faster than pure Python (6M characters in 15 minutes).

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch with multi-head self-attention, early stopping and perplexity evaluation.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
